race.comment: CHASING RAINBOWS (5) has to be the one to beat based on her lovely first campaign which ended in a very stylish victory. She has had multiple trials to get that fitness base and while bred to want 2000m in time, she has the right form credentials. I'M DA BOSS (2) went leading for the first time at Wangaratta and it turned his form around. Surely they try the same race style here. POSH DIAMANTE (8) gets back in her races and finds the line. Another who may end up a miler. OLATUNDE (3) resumes and has been readied with a Seymour jumpout win. Looks best of the rest.
